hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that implements a concentrated liquidity curve backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap it takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from the paired vault, and verifies a curve invariant — replacing the standard Uniswap v4 pool math entirely. Liquidity addition and donations are blocked to prevent unproductive positions.
